name: Tax Increment Financing (TIF) Annual Report - Analysis of Special Tax Allocation Fund

columns.name: TIF Number
columns.description: The unique, numeric ID assigned to the TIF district.

columns.name: TIF District
columns.description: Redevelopment project area

columns.name: Report Year
columns.description: Calendar year to which the record applies

columns.name: Tax Allocation Fund Balance
columns.description: The TIF balance at beginning of report year.

columns.name: Property Tax Increment - Current
columns.description: Amount of increment property tax revenue generated in a redevelopment area in a given report year

columns.name: Property Tax Increment - Cumulative
columns.description: Sum of all property tax incremental revenue generated from creation through the end of the report year

columns.name: Interest - Current
columns.description: Interest earnings on the Tax Allocation Fund Balance in the report year

columns.name: Interest - Cumulative
columns.description: Sum of all interest earnings to date

columns.name: Land/Building - Current
columns.description: Revenue from the sale of land/buildings that was used for industrial, residential, commercial or institutional purposes in the report year

columns.name: Land/Building - Cumulative
columns.description: Sum of all land/building sales revenue to date

columns.name: Bond - Current
columns.description: Proceeds from municipal and/or alternate revenue bonds deposited in the report year

columns.name: Bond - Cumulative
columns.description: Bond proceeds deposited from creation through the report year

columns.name: Note - Current
columns.description: Proceeds from Notes deposited in the report year

columns.name: Note - Cumulative
columns.description: Note proceeds deposited from creation through the report year

columns.name: Municipal - Current
columns.description: Revenue from property, sales, and other taxes and transfers from federal and state governments in the report year

columns.name: Municipal - Cumulative
columns.description: Sum of Revenue from Municipal to date

columns.name: Revenue from Other Sources
columns.description: Revenue from miscellaneous including note process, bond subsidiaries, non-compliance payment

columns.name: Revenue from Private Sources
columns.description: Sum of all private sector revenue to date

columns.name: Private - Current
columns.description: Revenue generated from a private sector entity in given report year

columns.name: Cash Expenses
columns.description: Total amount of cash expenditures in the report year

columns.name: Distribution of Surplus
columns.description: Property tax increment, not required for the payment of debt obligations or anticipated redevelopment project costs, that is returned to the County Collector for distribution to the taxing districts

columns.name: Transfers - Municipal
columns.description: Revenue transferred from other municipal sources in the report year

columns.name: Total Expenditure
columns.description: Total amount of expenditures in the report year

columns.name: Net Income
columns.description: Gross income minus taxes and other deductions in the report year

columns.name: Fund Balance
columns.description: The TIF balance at end of report Year

columns.name: Description of Debt Obligations
columns.description: Type of debt owed by municipality in the report year

columns.name: Amount of Original Debt Issuance
columns.description: The original amount of debt issued

columns.name: Amount Designated - Debt Obligations
columns.description: Total amount of funding allocated for debt obligations

columns.name: Descriptions of Project Costs to be Paid
columns.description: Type of project to where funds were previously allocated but not yet spent

columns.name: Amount Designated - Project Costs
columns.description: Total amount of funding allocated for projects costs

columns.name: Surplus/Deficit
columns.description: The amount of unspent TIF funds returned to the taxing bodies at the end of the year
